text:
jess: quick check — PR #4527 modifies the onprem agent to read SERVICE_KEY from env. Can someone from sec review secrets flow + any VPC/egress implications? diff: https://git.redwood/4527

alex: on it. main things I'll look for: plaintext logging, env leak to subprocesses, and if the key is ever written to disk. ETA ~1.5h

priya: pinging @alex — also please double-check the new curl command in the agent: it hits metadata service if run with --use-imds. we need to ensure we block that in private installs

alex: noted. saw this snippet in the PR: ```sh
echo "${SERVICE_KEY}" | ./agent --auth-from-stdin
```
alex: quick flag: avoid echo into pipes, use file descriptor or pass via stdin without echoing (echo can leak to process lists on some platforms)

jess: thanks. I can swap that to `printf '%s' "${SERVICE_KEY}" | ./agent --auth-from-stdin` in the next patch if that's preferred

dave: security-bot ran a quick scan on the branch: "potential-secret-pattern in file agent/config.go: line 78" — might be false positive (test key?), but worth checking before merge

security-bot: scan result: detected base64-like string in tests/fixtures/keys.json; flagged as potential secret. Recommend replacing with generated placeholder and adding commit to .gitignore for any test key files.

priya: for VPC/egress: clarify that onprem deployment should default to NO_OUTBOUND unless admin enables. The PR currently attempts a fallback to public model endpoints if private registry unavailable — that could cause unexpected egress in air-gapped installs

jess: good catch. I can gate the fallback behind a config flag `ALLOW_EXTERNAL_EGRESS=false` and make it opt-in for onprem images

alex: also add explicit KMS envelope encryption in the write path. Even if SERVICE_KEY is short-lived, we should never persist plaintext creds to disk. Code comment suggestion: "// persist only encrypted blob; decrypt at runtime using local KMS"

dave: quick code-review note: add a unit test asserting no write to /tmp in CI matrix; we've had regressions where dev envs wrote creds to /tmp

jess: will make changes: replace echo, add ALLOW_EXTERNAL_EGRESS flag, replace test keys, add KMS envelope + test for /tmp. I’ll push a follow-up commit in ~45m and ping this thread

alex: lgtm for now, will re-check after follow-up. thanks

priya: thanks — please cc infra when you push the flag so they can update the onprem docs and Helm chart values

jess: will do. tagging @infra in the follow-up. :thumbsup:

security-bot: note added: remind to run `make secret-scan` before marking ready-for-merge.
